source.snippet: Kindly help me to spot some active open source business applications projects built with the stack: NextJS React TypeScript MUI MongoDB. Business applications: Financial accounting, Sales, Purchase, Employee payroll, Production or an ERP suite.

problem_statement: Small and mid-size businesses want open-source ERP or business application suites (accounting, HR, sales) built on modern JS stacks (Next.js, React, TypeScript, MongoDB) rather than legacy PHP/Python stacks like Odoo or ERPNext.
target_segment: SMB owners and developers evaluating open-source ERP alternatives who are already invested in the Node/React ecosystem
notes: Recurring ask across dev forums. Odoo and ERPNext dominate but are Python/PHP based; a modern JS-stack ERP has a clear positioning gap. Signal is single question but maps to broader market pattern.
